bienvenida.title: WELCOME TO SAN ISIDRO
bienvenida.p1: We know that choosing a school for your children is probably one of the most important decisions you will face as parents. It means choosing the place that will accompany them through a key stage of their lives, where they will learn, grow, discover their talents and build bonds that leave a lasting mark.
bienvenida.p2: We know you are entrusting us with the most valuable thing you have. That is why we are committed to accompanying, caring for and educating every student in an environment of love, respect and joy, within a holistic, bilingual and Catholic-oriented education, sustained by high academic standards.
bienvenida.p3: We invite you to get to know our educational project and to discover what it means to be part of a community that grows, learns and transforms together.

pilares.intro: We believe that educating is much more than teaching. It means accompanying every student in discovering who they are and everything they can become, integrating every dimension of their growth into an education that leaves a lasting mark.

colegio.proyectoTitle: A holistic, bilingual and innovative education

introduccion.p1: San Isidro College opened its doors in 2016 with the purpose of offering the community of Salta a demanding and ambitious educational project, oriented towards a holistic, bilingual and Catholic education. Our proposal combines the contents established by the national education system with international programmes of high academic standards.
introduccion.p2: Bilingualism is part of our students' everyday experience. From the earliest years, English is incorporated intensively and naturally across different subjects, activities and learning experiences. In this way, every student progressively develops comprehension and oral expression, and gains the confidence needed to communicate in both languages.
introduccion.p3: Our proposal goes beyond the classroom. In a privileged natural setting, we create spaces for learning, meeting and participation through academic, cultural, recreational and sporting activities that foster the personal, intellectual, emotional and spiritual development of our students.
introduccion.p4: San Isidro College was conceived and developed with the support of specialised professionals and advisors from Salta, Buenos Aires and abroad. This outlook is enriched by international programmes, certifications and links with educational institutions that broaden learning opportunities and connect our students with the world.

mision.label: Mission
mision.texto: To educate global citizens through a holistic, bilingual and Catholic-oriented education that supports the personal, intellectual, emotional and spiritual growth of every student.

vision.label: Vision
vision.texto: To educate resilient and creative people, able to recognise opportunities, face new challenges, contribute to the progress of society and act with autonomy, responsibility and confidence in a constantly changing world.

escudo.title: Our crest, our identity
escudo.intro: Our crest tells who we are and what we believe in. Each of its symbols expresses a part of our identity and reminds us that educating also means sowing with love, accompanying with patience and trusting in the fruits that every student can bear.

aprendizajeValores.title: Learning through values
aprendizajeValores.p1: One of the fundamental goals of San Isidro College is to work as a team with the professionals who make up our community in order to educate free, creative, autonomous, responsible, honest and supportive students; with critical thinking, deep ethical and Christian values, able to face everyday challenges and committed to their own life project.
aprendizajeValores.p2: We seek to educate people who are aware of their duties and rights, proud of their history and their roots, respectful of their values and traditions and, at the same time, open to the world and able to understand and respect other cultures.
aprendizajeValores.p3: We work on learning through values in a systematic and planned way, as a cross-cutting theme that sustains the bonds of the whole school community. We believe values are not merely stated: they must be practised and expressed through everyday example. School is one of the privileged spaces to develop them through daily experiences and the constant support of our teachers.
aprendizajeValores.p4: Empathy and self-control translate into respect, solidarity, love for others and temperance. These learnings allow our students to build better relationships, strengthen their bonds, make friends and work as a team. We strive for kindness to be present in every interaction and for every member of our community to feel respected and valued.

educacionPersonalizada.title: Personalised education
educacionPersonalizada.p1: We believe that every student is unique: they have their own story, interests and talents, and a particular way of learning and relating to the world. That is why our educational proposal starts from knowing and listening to each person, in order to accompany them in discovering and developing their abilities.
educacionPersonalizada.p2: A student who feels heard, valued and emotionally supported gains greater confidence to participate, create, raise questions and dare to produce. They learn how to learn, because they understand that knowledge is built, expands and opens the door to new learning.
educacionPersonalizada.p3: Personalised education does not mean lowering expectations, but offering every student the tools and support they need to take an active role in their learning. Our teachers guide that process, progressively encourage autonomy and create opportunities to move forward and take on new challenges.
educacionPersonalizada.p4: We want every student to find the pleasure of coming to school, learning, meeting others and discovering different ways of expressing themselves through knowledge, sport and art. Along this path, the close bond between school and family is essential to accompany each stage of their growth consistently.

instalaciones.title: A school designed to be a school
instalaciones.videoAlt: Video of the San Isidro College facilities
instalaciones.p1: From the very beginning, every space at San Isidro College was designed to support school life. The layout, the classrooms, the furniture and the common areas were planned especially to favour learning, meeting, wellbeing and the safety of our students.
instalaciones.p2: Since its early days, the school has integrated technology in every classroom through interactive whiteboards and screens that enrich learning experiences and encourage active participation. Classrooms also feature modern, ergonomic furniture with natural light and ventilation, creating comfortable environments suited to each stage of growth.
instalaciones.p3: In Secondary, folding acoustic panels make it possible to expand or reorganise classrooms according to the needs of each activity, favouring flexible and collaborative learning experiences.
instalaciones.p4: The school is surrounded by large green areas that connect students with nature and offer different environments to learn, share, play and practise sports. It also has solar panels that harness a renewable energy source and reflect our commitment to caring for the environment and building a more sustainable community.
instalaciones.p5: Safety is also part of the design of our facilities. The different areas have emergency exits and doors that allow an orderly and safe evacuation whenever necessary.

introduccion.p1: As a Bilingual School, San Isidro College aims to achieve its educational goals in two languages. For this reason, English will be taught intensively through multiple activities and content.
introduccion.p2: Our Bilingual Project develops and builds from the earliest years of life, with a strong emphasis on correct pronunciation.
introduccion.p3: From a very young age, our children come into contact with their second language, responding to their communication and interaction needs. In this way, they learn to study, carry out activities, and “live” in English, graduating with knowledge and familiarity in the language that allows them to integrate comfortably into different English-speaking academic and work environments.
introduccion.p4: For this, the integrated curriculum plan in English and Spanish includes the corresponding International Certifications.
introduccion.p5: We work to facilitate and ensure the construction of a solid bond with the second language and foster confidence in students regarding their ability to learn it.
introduccion.bold1: Through an intensive reading and oral production program, children naturally incorporate English in their daily lives, similar to the process of acquiring their mother tongue, using content that responds to their interests and needs.
introduccion.bold2: Learning English from an early age allows them to easily acquire sounds, rhythms, and intonation. This way, we train their ear, achieving proper phonetics, ensuring comprehension, and initiating oral expression in a fun and natural way.

ingles.p1: In a globalized world, learning a second language is an ever-growing necessity.
ingles.p2: According to UNESCO documentation, in numerous international experiences, it is shown that teaching two or more languages reinforces other learning, especially the mother tongue (in both formative and instrumental aspects), and represents significant linguistic, cognitive, and socio-cultural benefits for students.
ingles.p3: On the socio-cultural level, the benefit lies in the fact that knowing other languages allows people not only to expand their scope of action by communicating with members of other cultures but also to understand and value different customs and worldviews, thereby living with diversity.
ingles.p4: Regarding how to access learning other languages, research shows that students’ learning is more meaningful and therefore longer-lasting when the language is used as a vehicle for learning other content and not only as an object of study in itself. Hence our Bilingual Educational Project proposal. Thus, bridges are built between the teaching of English and the rest of the curriculum areas: linguistic content is taught, and simultaneously, disciplinary content is approached.

kindergarten.p1: Our Bilingual Project starts in the nursery, K2, so that children are exposed to both languages throughout the day. The process continues in K3, K4, and K5.
kindergarten.p2: One of our objectives at this stage is to strengthen the mother tongue and work on the early acquisition of English as a second language, promoting familiarization with it through daily situations inside and outside the classroom, coordinating articulation with the primary level so that the transition to the next stage of education is natural and safe.
kindergarten.p3: Every day, we work with songs, dramatizations, puppets, stories, phrases, prompts, rhymes, intensified according to the group, until reaching full bilingualism at extended hours from age 5, where we work intensively with the English language to prepare them in the necessary language skills.
kindergarten.bold: They can create, imagine, explore, and develop fantasy, observe their environment, develop their creative and artistic capacity, and acquire tools that foster oral and written language practices, problem-solving, and attitudes linked to empathy and respect for others.
kindergarten.subtituloJuego: The Importance of Play in Early Childhood

juego.p1: Play, in all its forms, as content and work strategy
juego.p2: From the age of two, activities are based on play, the main source of learning for children. Play, spontaneous and natural in this stage, is the fundamental axis. It allows us to approach their interests, needs, and thought processes.
juego.p3: For them, learning through play is natural, so its value as a learning tool is indisputable.
juego.p4: Some benefits of play in children include its contribution to psychomotor, cognitive, social, and affective-moral development. Through play, they gain experiences about themselves and the world around them, rehearse adult roles and behaviors, train skills, practice routines and sequences of behavior that will be useful throughout their lives. They test their knowledge, learn the relevance of playing in groups, and learn to tolerate others’ viewpoints. Additionally, it helps strengthen affective bonds. The foundation and engine of all deep learning is this bond, which allows creating and strengthening trust.

primary.subtitulo: Our methodology is based on literature.
primary.p1: Mandatory subjects are carried out for all educational institutions (Jurisdictional Curriculum Design) and in English Areas: Language (Comprehension, Oral Language, Reading, Written Language, Creative Writing, Spelling), Drama, and Physical Education. Then the study plan adds: Literature, Social Studies, and Science.
primary.p2: In this level, it is important to promote the development of an attitude of effort, work, and responsibility in study and curiosity and interest in learning, strengthening confidence in one’s ability to learn.
primary.p3: Through play and varied activities appropriate to different ages, all aspects related to development and child evolution during the early years are covered. Special emphasis is placed on psychomotor, emotional, and intellectual development, stimulating curiosity, free thinking, moral awareness, and aesthetic enjoyment. We seek meaningful learning.
primary.p4: With a Bilingual Proposal, we work so that children can discover their talents and abilities. As a school prepared and advised by experienced professionals, we guarantee a natural incorporation of the English language as a second language. Thus, each student achieves broad language comprehension and expressive and communication skills.

secondary.p1: We prioritize a student-centered approach to develop key 21st-century skills such as autonomy, critical thinking, and creativity. With a solid bilingual foundation, we prepare our students for international exams and advanced technical English proficiency, tailored to their fields of study. We provide a space where learning comes to life.
secondary.p2Part2: standards, ensuring international quality education. We offer exchanges and study trips that enrich their training and broaden their world view, preparing them for future challenges.
secondary.diplomaDualTexto: Our students independently pursue the dual United States High School Diploma. This option gives them a competitive edge, allowing them to obtain both an Argentine and a U.S. high school diploma simultaneously, expanding their academic and professional opportunities internationally.

persona.title: The Center of Our Project: The Person
persona.backText: Our premise is clear: the person comes first. We prioritize student well-being and the development of an inclusive community where each learner feels valued. We seek integral growth, shaping young people with open minds and deep sensitivity to sustainability and social impact.

ciudadanos.title: Global Citizens with Academic Excellence
ciudadanos.backText: Through strong bilingual education, we prepare our students to thrive in an interconnected world. Our academic excellence strengthens teamwork as an essential 21st-century skill, curiosity to discover the world, critical thinking, and creativity to build an ethical life project.

innovacion.title: Innovation and Cutting-Edge Technology
innovacion.backText: Real innovation: students build their own prototypes from scratch (without commercial kits), integrating engineering and electronics. Artificial intelligence: advanced projects to lead in digital environments. Infrastructure: classrooms with interactive touch screens and a fully equipped high-complexity lab.

deportes.title: Sports
deportes.backText: Sports and healthy living: discipline and teamwork through Rugby, Hockey, and Jiu-Jitsu. With our own gym and tournament participation, we promote values such as respect, effort, solidarity, and enjoyment, while developing motor skills. Throughout the year, students join matches, tours, and competitions with other clubs, strengthening friendship, discipline, and belonging.

artes.title: Arts
artes.backText: The transformative power of art is a fundamental pillar for sensitivity and self-expression. Through different artistic languages, students develop new forms of communication, strengthening emotional intelligence, creativity, and abstract thinking. Art becomes a space of freedom that drives innovation and personal confidence.

sustentabilidad.title: Sustainability
sustentabilidad.backText: Sustainability is not just a concept, but a way of inhabiting the world. We educate young people with deep environmental and social awareness, capable of leading projects that create a positive impact in their surroundings. Through an ethical and responsible perspective, we integrate respect for nature and social equity, preparing global citizens committed to caring for our common home and future generations.

bienestar.title: Well-Being
bienestar.backText: To learn, students must first feel well. That is why the integral well-being of our students is at the core of our educational commitment: the person comes first. We sustain an inclusive community where every young person feels heard, valued, and safe.

academicProposal.title: Academic Proposal: Excellence and International Dual Diploma
academicProposal.p1: During the five years of Secondary School, we provide a full-day bilingual comprehensive education, combining the official Argentine curriculum with global competitiveness standards through international programs.
academicProposal.orientationsTitle: Our proposal is diversified into two tracks:

internationalProjection.title: International Projection: Cambridge and High School Diploma
internationalProjection.intro: We understand that today's world has no borders. Therefore, we strengthen our graduates' profiles with globally valid certifications.

igcse.label: IGCSE Program (University of Cambridge):

dual.text: starting in 2nd year, we offer the possibility to pursue this international validation program. Through an online platform with native teachers, students simultaneously obtain the local high school diploma and the American High School Diploma.

internationalProjection.closing: This linguistic and technological immersion experience positions them with a unique competitive advantage to enter the best universities in the world.

identity.title: Our Identity: The Life Project
identity.p1: At San Isidro College, we understand that Secondary School is the stage where potential transforms into identity. Our goal is for each student to graduate with a solid, conscious, and autonomous Life Project.
identity.p2: We support each young person in discovering their purpose through a proposal that balances technological innovation and human warmth.

intro.p1: At San Isidro College, we understand that educating means accompanying. Our students' wellbeing is a core pillar of our educational proposal, because feeling supported, safe, and heard is essential to learn, grow, and develop their full potential.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.p1: Educating means much more than transmitting knowledge. It means supporting each student at every stage of their growth, helping them develop confidence, autonomy, empathy, and the tools they need to face life's challenges.
philosophy.p2: At San Isidro College, we want every student to find a place where they can learn, grow, and build healthy relationships within a community that knows and supports them.

community.title: A community that supports
community.p1: Wellbeing does not depend on one person or one team alone. It is the result of the commitment of the entire educational community.
community.p2: Teachers, tutors, coordinators, and school leaders work closely to know each student, support their journey, and create a school climate based on respect, trust, and a sense of belonging.

closing.title: Supporting growth

That is why we promote a culture of care where wellbeing, closeness, and guidance are part of the educational experience every day. Our commitment is to provide each student with the tools, support, and confidence they need to grow, learn, and develop their full potential.

trabajoFamilias.title: Working with families

sostenEmocional.title: Emotional support

lab.p1: Our lab brings together different tools and technologies so students can investigate, build, and learn actively.

closing.p1: Our Innovation and Robotics Lab expresses San Isidro College's commitment to innovative education. Together with our technological proposal and our recognition as a Google Reference School, this space encourages students to learn, create, and develop the skills that will allow them to move confidently in the world of tomorrow.

intro.p1: San Isidro College, located in a privileged natural setting, develops a varied Physical Education program as part of the Pedagogical Project, which aims to contribute to shaping a life plan.
intro.p2: Physical Education represents much more than a curriculum area at our school. It becomes a fundamental discipline for the comprehensive education and formation of the human being, especially when implemented at an early age, as it allows children and adolescents to develop motor, cognitive, and affective skills essential for daily life and as part of a healthy lifestyle and social interaction. Through it, they express their spontaneity and learn to know, respect, and value themselves and others.
intro.p3: Therefore, it is essential to include and experience different activities in play, gymnastics, and sports, in order to implement them continuously, either in class or through educational projects. Creating a habit of physical activity allows students, beyond school, to feel healthy and active, incorporating these practices into their free time.

bienestar.title: Student Well-Being
bienestar.p1: At San Isidro College, we value the well-being of our students, considering it essential for their holistic development. We strive to create an environment where they feel safe, content, and happy—key factors for them to excel and achieve success.
bienestar.p2: We promote student well-being through a patient, positive, and proactive approach led by trained and experienced teachers, involving the entire educational community. Our educational system, based on diversity and the PSHE curriculum, is designed to focus on each student’s comprehensive well-being.
bienestar.p3: Tutors play a crucial role by getting to know each student and building a trusting relationship, providing both practical and emotional support. Our tutoring system aims to foster personal and social growth, instilling a sense of responsibility and health awareness. We monitor academic progress and encourage good study habits.
bienestar.p4: We encourage parents to communicate with tutors about any concern, no matter how small, related to their child’s health and well-being. Through an enriching environment, we help students thrive both academically and emotionally.
